notes.title: Some improvements
notes.notes: [p]In this small update we bring some improvements regarding the gamepad in main menu and pause menu, some adjustments in resolutions other than fullHD, correction of the error that prevented the music from playing when returning to the main menu, smoother scene transitions and improvements in the level design of levels 7 and 8, making 7 easier and 8 more difficult.[/p]

notes.title: Balloomia 1.9.4
notes.notes: [p]Hello! In this update we bring the implementation of the Options menu that is fully functional and is activated from the home menu. When it is called from pause menu, we noticed that the sensitivity is not being applied, an issue that we will solve in the next update.[/p]

notes.title: New and more fixes
notes.notes:
Balloomia demo is now in 1.9.3 version, and in it we bring more fixes for 4k resolution and 16:10 resolutions.
In addition to other small UI fixes and level design, we now have an introductory screen for each level, wich means, now you will know the number of the level you are in and a preview of what to expect from it.

notes.title: Small fixes and new level
notes.notes:
In 1.9.2 version we made some more UI adjustments to improve experience for those playing in higher resolutions (such as 2k and 4k).
In addition, we improved controls sensibility on the Steam Deck, and we also fixed the time in Speedrun mode that was resetting to the initial value of the level, every time there was a fall.

And a really good news: one more level in both modes!

notes.title: Another one in the basket.
notes.notes:
The previous update had a side effect, changing the logic of the time spent in the levels when the message appears once you reach the Gashan machine (ball machine).
In addition to correcting this issue, some small visual adjustments regards to text size were made.

notes.title: Significant Update!
First bug fix!
Demo is out now!
notes.notes:
Balloomia: Sky Playground demo 1.7 is out now!
What you gonna find:
- 8 levels to play;
- Default mode;
- Speedrun mode.
- A lot of fun.

Later this month it will be more updates with:
- New cursor;
- Leaderboard for speedrun.

Leave us a feedback in the community session if you face any bug.

Cheers!
